title: Not good for what I need it for
text:
Not good for what I need it for. I bought this to use for bento-style lunches for my 4 school-aged children. I saw it reviewed on a lunch blog and all of the glowing reviews here on Amazon. I guess I should have read the reviews more closely. Yes I could see this would cut tofu cubes up well but guess what... we don't eat tofu.

Did not cut PB&J well at all (lots of other reviews agree on that one). I tried to cut up a turkey burger. It wasn't strong enough and squished all of the "juice" out of the burger in the attempt. It did OK but didn't knock my socks off for a Ham and cheese sandwich. There is a lot of waste when cutting sandwiches since the cutter is rectangular instead of square. I tried with waffles and it was again OK but kind of squished. The cutting edge needs to be sharper. And again a LOT of waste.

Oh lastly... it says it is dishwasher safe on top rack IF you attach the two pieces together. Well that's pointless because the water can't get in there to clean it. So that's really code for handwash only.

I wish I could return it. Total waste!
